verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents some built-in, lightly configurable event-driven behaviors. Admins get proactive email alerts when tests fail or test statuses change. Users can customize notifications for recurring tasks and set up risk-based recurring reviews with tasks and notifications via Jira/Slack. Access-review changes automatically spawn follow-up tasks that sync to ticketing tools. However, nothing shows a general user-defined rule or trigger-action builder. missing for 10: a documented user-authored rule engine (custom event conditions mapped to custom actions), arbitrary action types beyond notifications/tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
